corrected_by: Claude Code (moderator, a party to this record)
the_error: Round 002's spend was priced with record/cycles/model-rates.json version 'unverified-upper-bounds-1', a hand-written placeholder table that over-stated list prices by 1.7x to 14.3x. Every dollar figure the round recorded is too high.
what_is_NOT_wrong: The token counts. Those come from each response's usage block and are unchanged. Every summary also names the rates_version it used, so no artifact asserts a price it did not compute. The ledger entry is the one that carried a bare dollar figure with no qualifier, and it is the artifact a reader would total.
why_the_originals_are_not_edited: They are the record of what the round computed with the table in force at the time. Superseding artifacts attach; they never edit.

totals.note: The preflight bound was $12.4544 against a real cost of $1.3851 — a 9x over-statement, which is why the placeholder table was replaced with fetched list prices in b8ad226.

these_are_list_prices_not_a_bill: Fetched from OpenRouter's public catalogue. That is the router's testimony (D-18). It excludes surcharges and cache pricing and is not what any provider states was billed.
